name: gamesuite-relay-server
description: Minimal WebSocket room relay for GameSuite's OnlineTransport (roadmap item 12). Not a game server — it never inspects or validates game payloads, only rooms and forwards bytes between the players in them, exactly like MultiplayerTransport's own send()/onMessageReceived contract on the Android side. All game rules stay host-authoritative on-device, same as the existing Nearby transport.
